title: Dynamics 365 Developer
summary: A Dynamics 365 developer customises Microsoft's CRM (customer relationship management: sales, service and customer data) with code such as C# plugins and JavaScript form scripts, and connects it to other systems. They usually work in a CRM practice of an IT services firm or a company's own IT team, alongside functional consultants and testers.
dailyDuties: Write and register C# plugins for business rules
Write JavaScript for forms, fields and ribbon buttons
Build integrations with other systems over APIs
Build Power Automate flows on CRM data
Move solutions from development to test and production
Fix issues raised by users and functional consultants

skills.expectation: Customise Dynamics 365 Sales or Customer Service: tables, forms, views and security roles
Write and register plugins, custom workflow activities and form scripts
Write plugins and integration code in C#
Write form and ribbon scripts with the Dynamics client API
Query Dataverse with FetchXML, QueryExpression and the Web API
Integrate Dynamics 365 with other systems over REST and SOAP
Build Power Automate flows that run on Dynamics 365 data
Build model-driven or canvas apps on the same data
Write form scripts and PCF controls in TypeScript
Use Azure Functions, Service Bus or Logic Apps for integrations
Move solutions between environments with Azure DevOps pipelines
Query SQL Server for reports and data migration
Turn functional consultant notes into technical designs
